home.title: Arrival kit
home.lead: Procedures, housing, health, banking, transport: practical resources proposed by members, dated, sourced and reviewed by someone else before they are published.
home.trustNote: A community resource does not replace official information: always check with the cited source.

unavailable.title: The arrival kit is not available here yet.
unavailable.body: This data provider does not serve this section yet: nothing is made up in its place.

zone.label: Area shown
zone.cityHint: Type a city, no location tracking. Empty: the whole country.

statusNote.draft: Draft: only the people managing it can see it. Submit it for review to publish it.
statusNote.submitted: Submitted: another authorised person must review it before it is published.
statusNote.published: Published: it appears in the arrival kit.
statusNote.needs_review: Needs review: update it with a recent check of the source.
statusNote.archived: Withdrawn: it no longer appears in the kit and can no longer be edited.

reviewCause.age: Its source was checked more than twelve months ago.
reviewCause.flags: Several members reported it as outdated.
reviewCause.reviewer: A reviewer asked for it to be updated.

outdatedReason.link_broken: The source link no longer works

feedback.savedDraft: New version saved as a draft.
feedback.returned: Resource sent back to its author.
feedback.flagged: Thank you: your report has been recorded.

list.emptyTitle: No reviewed resource for this area
list.emptyBody: Resources appear here once someone else has reviewed them; they are dated and cite their source.

card.moderationPending: Under moderation review: the kit does not show it to other members yet.
card.moderationRemoved: Rejected by moderation: the kit no longer shows it, and it can no longer be edited.

propose.title: Propose a resource
propose.description: Another authorised person will review it before it appears in the kit.
propose.statusInsufficient: To propose a resource, your DIASPORALE membership must first be declared.
propose.carrierHint: A resource is only shown as official when it is carried by a page with the Official badge.

form.title: Title
form.summaryHint: One or two sentences, between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.
form.bodyHint: Steps, required documents, timelines. No phone number, email address or link: the source has its own field.
form.cityHint: Empty: the resource applies to the whole country.
form.sourceNameHint: The website or service that publishes this information.
form.sourceUrlHint: Full address, starting with https://. Tracking parameters (utm_…) are removed.
form.verifiedOnHint: The day you checked the information with the source; it stays valid for twelve months.
form.editDescription: A new version, reviewed before it returns to the kit.
form.editNotice: The new version leaves the public kit until it is reviewed, and its reports start again from zero.

detail.unavailableBody: It does not exist, was withdrawn, or has not been reviewed yet.
detail.needsReviewBody: This information may be out of date: check it with the source before relying on it.
detail.sourceDemo: Fictional demo source: no link is offered.
detail.sourceNoLink: No safe link is available for this source.
detail.sourceAdvice: The source is the reference: always check the information with it.
detail.people: Who carries it and who reviewed it
detail.author: Proposed by
detail.officialNote: Resource carried by a page with the Official badge.
detail.communityNote: Community resource reviewed by someone else: it does not replace official information.

actions.title: Act on this resource
actions.flagged: You reported this version as outdated.
actions.flagDescription: Your report applies to this version; from {{threshold}} reports by different people, the resource is shown as needing review.
actions.returnTitle: Send the resource back to its author
actions.returnDescription: It becomes a draft again; its author reads your reason, without your name.
actions.markTitle: Mark the resource as needing review
actions.markDescription: It stays visible with a warning until it is updated; its author reads your reason.
actions.reasonHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters, without contact details.
actions.withdrawBody: It will leave the arrival kit and can no longer be edited or republished.

queue.title: To review ({{country}})
queue.lead: Review a resource you did not write: check its source and date, then publish it or send it back with a reason.
queue.empty: No resource is awaiting review in this country.
queue.label: Review queue

mine.title: My proposals
mine.lead: The resources you proposed, in every state.
mine.empty: You have not proposed any resource yet.
mine.emptyBody: A resource useful to newcomers? Propose it: someone else will review it before it is published.

errors.arrival_kit_summary_too_long: The summary is too long: one or two sentences are enough.
errors.arrival_kit_body_too_short: The content is too short: give the steps, documents or timelines.
errors.arrival_kit_contact_details_forbidden: No phone number, email address or link in the text: the source address has its own field.
errors.arrival_kit_category_invalid: Choose a section from the list.
errors.arrival_kit_country_is_home: The arrival kit covers diaspora countries, not Gabon.
errors.arrival_kit_city_too_long: The city name is too long.
errors.arrival_kit_city_invalid: Enter a city name, without a number or an address.
errors.arrival_kit_source_name_too_short: Enter the name of the source.
errors.arrival_kit_source_name_too_long: The source name is too long.
errors.arrival_kit_source_url_invalid: This address is not valid: enter the full address of a public website.
errors.arrival_kit_source_url_not_https: The source address must start with https://.
errors.arrival_kit_verified_at_in_future: The verification date cannot be in the future.
errors.arrival_kit_verified_at_too_old: This check is more than twelve months old: check the information with the source again.
errors.arrival_kit_outdated_reason_invalid: Choose a reason from the list.
errors.arrival_kit_transition_invalid: This action is not possible in the resource's current state.
errors.arrival_kit_archived: This resource has been withdrawn: it can no longer be edited.
errors.arrival_kit_version_conflict: The resource changed in the meantime: reload it before trying again.
errors.arrival_kit_reviewer_not_eligible: Reviewing is open to verified members and page managers.
errors.arrival_kit_review_own_resource: You cannot review a resource you wrote or that your page carries.
errors.arrival_kit_not_flaggable: Only a published resource can be reported.
errors.arrival_kit_flag_own_resource: You cannot report your own resource: edit it instead.
errors.arrival_kit_already_flagged: You have already reported this version.
errors.arrival_kit_resource_limit_reached: You have reached the maximum number of resources in progress: withdraw one before proposing another.
errors.arrival_kit_page_kind_not_allowed: Only institution, association or community pages can carry an arrival kit resource.
